blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sibol may have settled for bronze in the Pokémon Unite event of the 2026 Asian Games esports competition, but the medal marked a breakthrough for a game its coach described as non-mainstream in the Philippines. “You can achieve your dream by just giving a non-mainstream game a chance,” Sibol Pokémon Unite coach Albert Camp told the Inquirer. “There were moments na nakaka-down kasi hindi kami napapansin kahit anong ganda ng achievements namin pero we didn’t give up, we didn’t stick to the status quo–not just in other MOBA.” While the Philippines has a large Pokémon fan base, local […]...
